preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 100000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100000) representing the number of test cases.
Test cases are separated by an empty line (except possibly after the last test case).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n'))
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with a line containing two integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 10^6), where n is the number of residents/cats and m is the number of friendship pairs.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a_i) <= n and 1 <= int(b_i) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n') and len(line.split()) == 2 and line != stdin.splitlines()[0])
preconditions.description: Each friendship pair (a_i, b_i) satisfies 1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n, where a_i is a resident and b_i is a cat.

preconditions.expression: all(any(line.split() == [str(i), str(i)] for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n') and len(line.split()) == 2) for i in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: For every resident i (1 ≤ i ≤ n), there exists a friendship pair (i, i) indicating the resident owns the i-th cat.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['Yes', 'No'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() and not stdout_line.startswith('\n'))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of output is either 'Yes' (indicating a valid selection exists) or 'No' (indicating no valid selection exists).

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in stdout_line and (len(stdout_line.split()) == 2 or len(stdout_line.split()) == 1) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() == 'Yes')
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is printed, the next line must contain two integers j and p (1 ≤ j, 1 ≤ p, j + p = n) representing the number of jury members and contestants, respectively.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in stdout_line and all(1 <= int(resident) <= n for resident in stdout_line.split()[2:]) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() == 'Yes' and len(stdout_line.split()) > 2)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is printed, the third line must contain j distinct integers (1 ≤ resident ≤ n) representing the jury members.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in stdout_line and all(1 <= int(cat) <= n for cat in stdout_line.split()[2:]) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() == 'Yes' and len(stdout_line.split()) > 2 and 'jury' not in stdout_line.lower())
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is printed, the fourth line must contain p distinct integers (1 ≤ cat ≤ n) representing the contestant cats.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in stdout_line and len(set(stdout_line.split()[2:])) == len(stdout_line.split()[2:]) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() == 'Yes' and len(stdout_line.split()) > 2)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is printed, the jury members and contestant cats must be distinct within their respective lists.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in stdout_line and all(not any(line.split() == [str(resident), str(cat)] for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n') and len(line.split()) == 2) for resident in stdout_line.split()[2:] for cat in stdout_line.split()[4:]) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() == 'Yes' and len(stdout_line.split()) > 4)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is printed, no jury member (resident) can be acquainted with any contestant cat (i.e., no friendship pair (resident, cat) exists between them).

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in stdout_line and len(stdout_line.split()[2:]) + len(stdout_line.split()[4:]) == n for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() == 'Yes' and len(stdout_line.split()) > 4)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is printed, the total number of jury members and contestants must sum to n.

postconditions.expression: all('Yes' in stdout_line and len(stdout_line.split()[2:]) >= 1 and len(stdout_line.split()[4:]) >= 1 for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip() == 'Yes' and len(stdout_line.split()) > 4)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is printed, there must be at least one jury member and at least one contestant.
